ValidationRule.description: VR-QUOTE-20: Quote status-transition guard. (1) In Review only from Draft; (2) Rejected is terminal (only Void allowed). Blocks manual backward transitions via Edit; re-quote via Revise. Merges old VR_QUOTE_20 + 21.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'In Review'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Draft')) ), AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Rejected'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Void')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Quote status change. "In Review" can only be set from "Draft" (via Submit for Review), and a Rejected quote can only be Voided. To re-quote, use Revise Quote to create a new version.
